# Client summary — Brightsmile Dental online booking

> Generated from `requirements/requirements.json` (run 2026-10-10T09:00Z). Do not edit this file by hand; change the JSON and regenerate.

## The problem

Patients can only book by phoning the front desk during opening hours.

## Objectives

- Let patients book appointments outside opening hours without phoning

## Proposed first release (MVP)

- **FR-001** Book an appointment online **[Explicit]** (MUST)
- **FR-002** Send booking confirmation email **[Explicit]** (SHOULD)
- **BR-001** Booking window of 24 hours to 60 days **[Explicit]** (MUST)
- **BR-002** A booked slot is no longer free **[Explicit]** (MUST)
- **NFR-001** Booking page load time **[Unknown]** (SHOULD)
- **CON-001** ClinicDesk remains the master calendar **[Explicit]** (MUST)
- **IR-001** Read availability from and write bookings to ClinicDesk **[Inferred]** (MUST)

## Decisions we need from you first

- **Q-004** How does a patient identify themselves when booking: an online account, or details checked against ClinicDesk (e.g. name, date of birth, phone)?
- **Q-005** In which country does the practice operate, and which health-data regulations apply to booking data?

All 8 client questions are in open-questions.md.

## Main risks

- **RISK-001** ClinicDesk may not support reading slots or writing bookings: Confirm ClinicDesk API access and terms with the vendor before design starts; plan a short technical spike.
- **RISK-003** Health-data obligations unknown: Get the jurisdiction from the client early and review obligations before architecture work.

## Ideas for discussion (not part of the requirements)

- **INN-001** Automatic reminders: A timely nudge before the visit.
- **INN-002** Personal calendar sync: One tap adds the visit to their calendar.
- **INN-012** Visual availability calendar: See the soonest slot at a glance.
- **INN-003** Core Web Vitals budget: A quick page on phones.
- **INN-006** One-tap reschedule links: Move a visit without calling.

The full list of 33 ideas is in innovation-opportunities.md.

## Next steps

1. Answer the questions above.
2. Review the proposed priorities in requirements.md and sign off.
